scope: Advice inventory navigation CPU boundaries and frozen public SGLang Git text/metadata; no SGLang execution, model quality, token savings or scheduler deployment

implementation.procedure: Replay fixed source-bound navigation and real CLI tests.
implementation.acceptance: First/unchanged/append/archive-edit/delete/multi-content events preserve source bindings; no original writes.

reference_boundary.procedure: Replay eight boundary cases plus seven unchanged global advice-gate regressions.
reference_boundary.acceptance: Invalid/foreign/null baselines, path escape, links, unreadable subtrees, budgets and observed churn reject; archive/empty events never grant closure.

data_integrity.procedure: Check complete frozen source set, plan/config, producer data and public-source metadata.
data_integrity.acceptance: All hashes exact; structured producer run15, errors/failures0, native link skip explicit, no model usage inferred.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Recompute inventory totals and fixed test counts from raw bindings.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Frozen SGLang live2/archive52, live20587/archive636293 bytes; source facts agree with original GETs; no bytes-to-token conversion.

measurement_validity.procedure: Check CPU-only environment and fixed inputs; distinguish developer preliminary tests and reports.
measurement_validity.acceptance: No SGLang code/GPU or paid model A/B; do not count this as TOK-010 or claim total workflow costs.

reproducibility.procedure: Different-owner fixed host invocation replays CPU suite, CLI and source receipts.
reproducibility.acceptance: Current root and complete eight source bindings; WSL link test runs; exact scientific results not reverified.
